newsitem.title: CHINA: China wheat purchases reach 80 pct of 1996 target.
newsitem.headline: China wheat purchases reach 80 pct of 1996 target.

text.p: China's total state purchases of wheat reached 18.53 million tonnes by the end of August, accounting for 80.26 percent of the target for 1996, the official People's Daily said on Sunday.
Of the total, purchases of wheat at state-fixed prices were 13.11 million tonnes, more than 90 percent of the year's target, the newspaper said. The state also buys at market prices.
The state bought 1.95 million tonnes of rapeseed, fulfilling 66.21 percent of state plans, it said.
China's grain output was expected to be a record 475 million tonnes in 1996, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.
